answer: Port-rotation bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity charters one walnut voyage and locks 70 credits. Each epoch the registry assigns a different port; the voyage presents its yarrow consignment there inside the window for countersigning. A reused countersignature burns the bond; one master cannot sign two voyages in one window, so a rented-port ring fails. First 30; k-th 30+8(k-1); 1000 fakes cost 4,026,000 plus 70,000 locked; honest pay 30 once.
